{{Top}}
A '''hydrosphere''' referred to the combined mass of [[Water/Legends|water]] comprising a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] physical geography. The [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] planet [[Sanctuary/Legends|Sanctuary]], for example, had a moist hydrosphere.
